subject: Mathematics
source_note: TIE (2023), Mathematics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in geometry and algebra

sub_topics.title: Use geometry, approximations, relations and functions in various contexts
competences: (a) Describe the concepts of relations and functions (linear and quadratic) (types of relations, domain and range of relations, graphs of relations and functions, inverse of relations, and functions)
(b) Find the domain and range of relations and functions
(c) Find the inverses of relations and functions
(d) Draw graphs of relations and functions

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concepts of relations and functions (linear and quadratic) (types of relations, domain and range of relations, graphs of relations and functions, inverse of relations, and functions)
objectives.teaching_methods: Collaborative learning, Exploration, Visual representation, Project
objectives.resources: Function animation, graph boards and papers, calculators, charts of real life scenarios Mathematical software such as Mathematica, GeoGebra
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts of relations and functions are clearly described

objectives.text: (b) Find the domain and range of relations and functions
objectives.assessment_criteria: Domain and range of relations and functions are clearly described

objectives.text: (c) Find the inverses of relations and functions
objectives.assessment_criteria: The inverse of relations and functions are correctly found

objectives.text: (d) Draw graphs of relations and functions
objectives.assessment_criteria: The graphs of relations and functions are correctly drawn

sub_topics.title: Use algebra and matrices in problem solving
competences: Explore the basic tenets of algebra (linear programming: constraints, objective functions, and optimal solution)

objectives.text: Explore the basic tenets of algebra (linear programming: constraints, objective functions, and optimal solution)
objectives.teaching_methods: Jigsaw, Graphical methods, Use of technology, Problems solving
objectives.resources: Function animation, graph boards and papers, calculators, charts of real life scenarios Mathematical software such as Mathematica, GeoGebra
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts of linear programming are clearly explored

sub_topics.title: Use sets, sequences and series in problem solving
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of sequences and series (Arithmetic progression AP, Geometric progression GP)
(b) Find the general term for AP and GP and use them to derive formulae for the sums of APs and GPs
(c) Calculate arithmetic mean, geometric mean, and compound interest

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of sequences and series (Arithmetic progression AP, Geometric progression GP)
objectives.resources: Pattern puzzles, pattern blocks, visual aids, sequence and series games and applications, calculators,
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts of sequences and series are clearly explored

objectives.text: (b) Find the general term for AP and GP and use them to derive formulae for the sums of APs and GPs
objectives.assessment_criteria: The formulae for the sum of APs and GPs are correctly derived

objectives.text: (c) Calculate arithmetic mean, geometric mean, and compound interest
objectives.assessment_criteria: The arithmetic mean, geometric mean, and compound interest are correctly found

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in coordinate geometry, trigonometry, circles, vectors, probability and statistics

sub_topics.title: Use basic skills of circles in daily life
competences: Explore the basic tenets of a circle (angle properties, theorems, tangents, chords and radians)

objectives.text: Explore the basic tenets of a circle (angle properties, theorems, tangents, chords and radians)
objectives.resources: Charts of circle theorems, circle theorems animations, circle simulations, mathematical sets, visual aids, Mathematical software such as GeoGebra,
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of circle is clearly explored
